Need more storage for your Linode instance? In this tutorial, I’ll show you how to create, attach, and mount block storage volumes on Linode, giving your Linux cloud server additional storage without having to rebuild your instance.

We’ll explore two different ways to create block storage volumes using Akamai Cloud Manager, walk through the process of mounting additional storage in Linux, and more!
